acquisition method: Twenty tandem mass spectra were collected in a data-dependent manner following each survey scan.
cleavage agent: followed by trypsin digestion and peptide desalting.
collision energy: Normalized collision energy was set at 27.
enrichment method: Biotinylated proteins were recovered using neutravidin beads
fractionation method: The flow-through peptides were separated with high pH reversed-phase offline fractionation cartridges into four fractions
instrument: electrospray benchtop Orbitrap mass spectrometer (RSLCnano and Q Exactive HF-X, Thermo Fisher Scientific)
labeling: Cleaned peptides were labeled with TMT10plex isobaric labeling reagent
reduction reagent: DTT as a reducing agent to break disulfide bonds between biotin and nitrosylated cysteines
